title: 事故调查与根本原因分析
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/162_事故调查与根本原因分析.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/162_事故调查与根本原因分析/src.py

points.S2: 鱼骨图：六个方面找原因

shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a big magnifying glass and looks at the camera.
shots.narration: 第14章第八课：事故调查与根本原因分析。
overlay: 事故调查与根本原因分析

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁是一棵树的根
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a tree whose roots are shown below the ground.
shots.narration: 出了事，要一直挖到根上。

shots.scene: 阿杰连续移液几个小时
shots.prompt_en: In a university lab, the young male student pipettes sample after sample at the bench, a wall clock showing many hours passed.
shots.narration: 阿杰连着移液几个小时，没休息。

shots.scene: 阿杰手一抖，烧瓶倒了，溶液洒出
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's hand trembles and a flask tips over, liquid spilling across the bench.
shots.narration: 手一抖，烧瓶倒了，溶液洒了一台。

shots.scene: 处置完毕后，老周说：写上下次注意
shots.prompt_en: After the spill is cleaned up, the older man shrugs and says something casually, a speech bubble with a warning icon.
shots.narration: 老周说：写个“下次注意”就行吧？

shots.scene: 王老师摇头，拿出放大镜
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shakes her head and holds up a magnifying glass and a blank report form.
shots.narration: 王老师说：先把原因查清楚。

shots.scene: 调查的目的：同样的事不再发生
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over an accident icon, an arrow to a repeated accident icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 调查，是为了同样的事不再发生。

shots.scene: 找根本原因、定纠正措施、满足规定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a root, a wrench and a rule book, each with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 找根本原因，定措施，符合规定。

shots.scene: 只为应付检查和留档案，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report filed straight into a cabinet for an inspector, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不是为了应付检查、留个档案。

shots.scene: 未遂和小事故也要调查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a near miss icon and a small injury icon also under the magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 事故要查，险情和小事故也要查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier on a chain of event icons, a pointing finger at a person crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 查清事实，不是为了找人出气。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gavel icon and a hiding icon, both crossed out next to a magnifier with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 不是为了定罪，也不是躲检查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: students speaking openly at a table, speech bubbles with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 不追责，大家才敢说实话。

shots.scene: 危险还在，调查员冲进去，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an investigator with a clipboard walking into a smoking lab, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 危险没排除，先别急着调查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a green check over a ventilated lab with the gas valve closed and power off, the investigator entering. No text.
shots.narration: 确认安全，再进入现场。

shots.scene: 调查的人不能成为新伤者
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an investigator wearing gloves and goggles, a shield icon. No text.
shots.narration: 调查的人，不能成为新的伤者。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a spill area left untouched while a mop is held back, only first aid allowed. No text.
shots.narration: 除了抢救需要，先别急着清理。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone camera photographing a tipped flask, a bottle label and a pipette on the bench. No text.
shots.narration: 拍下位置、标签和用过的器材。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an instrument with a blank out of service tag and a barrier around it. No text.
shots.narration: 涉事设备先停用、隔离。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock icon and a fading memory cloud, an investigator talking with a witness. No text.
shots.narration: 趁记忆清楚，尽快问清经过。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: after photos are taken, a spill kit is used to clean up and waste goes into a labeled container. No text.
shots.narration: 记录完，再按规定清理和处置。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a camera, an eye and a pen writing a short statement. No text.
shots.narration: 拍照录像、观察、写陈述，是记录。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: barrier tape stretched around the spill area. No text.
shots.narration: 拉警戒带，是保护现场。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the camera icon and the barrier tape icon joined with a plus sign. No text.
shots.narration: 保护和记录，两件事都要做。

shots.scene: 负责人、安全员、学院组成调查组
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small team of the safety administrator, the older man and a college officer around a table. No text.
shots.narration: 按规定成立调查组，分工调查。

shots.scene: 严重事故由学校和有关部门调查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bigger team with a university office icon and a government building icon. No text.
shots.narration: 事故大，由学校和有关部门调查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a broken flask, an experiment notebook, a security camera and a person speaking. No text.
shots.narration: 物证、记录、监控、证人，都是证据。

shots.scene: 实验记录本和设备日志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an experiment notebook and an instrument log sheet laid next to each other. No text.
shots.narration: 查看实验记录、设备和排班记录。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator talks calmly with the young male student at a quiet table, taking notes.
shots.narration: 访谈，是为了准确还原经过。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a timeline with small event icons in order, a question mark over each. No text.
shots.narration: 按时间顺序，问清每一步。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an angry investigator pointing a finger at a nervous student, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不指责，大家才愿意说实话。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a big puzzle of the accident broken into separate pieces, people, equipment, materials and methods. No text.
shots.narration: 分析，就是把整件事拆成几部分。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the puzzle pieces examined one by one with a magnifier, then lines connecting them. No text.
shots.narration: 一块块看清，再找出它们的关联。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a horizontal timeline with icons, start of work, long hours, trembling hand and spill. No text.
shots.narration: 先画时间线，理清前因后果。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a trembling hand knocking over a flask, labeled with a single arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 直接原因：手抖碰倒了烧瓶。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tired student icon and a clock showing many hours, a second arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 间接原因：连干几小时，太疲劳。

shots.scene: 行为背后：培训、排班、设备
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: behind a person icon, three hidden icons of training, a shift schedule and a heavy manual pipette. No text.
shots.narration: 行为背后，常有培训排班设备问题。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: all arrows pointing only at one student, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只怪个人，以后就没人敢报告。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a procedure sheet with a skipped step being rewritten with a clearer layout. No text.
shots.narration: 赶工跳步，就去改规程和安排。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chain starting with a spill icon and a question mark, the first link showing a trembling hand. No text.
shots.narration: 为什么洒了？因为手抖了。

shots.scene: 为什么手抖？连续几小时
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the next link showing a clock with many hours. No text.
shots.narration: 为什么手抖？连干几小时没歇。

shots.scene: 为什么不歇？一个人赶进度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the next link showing one person alone with a deadline calendar. No text.
shots.narration: 为什么不歇？一个人赶全部样品。

shots.scene: 为什么一个人？没有排班和休息规定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the last link showing an empty schedule sheet and a missing rule icon, a root icon below it. No text.
shots.narration: 为什么？没有排班和休息安排。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tree with its roots exposed, a shovel reaching the deepest root. No text.
shots.narration: 一直问，直到找到系统问题。

shots.section_title: 鱼骨图：六个方面找原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fishbone diagram with the spill at the head and six blank bones. No text.
shots.narration: 也可以画鱼骨图，找全原因。
overlay: 鱼骨图：六个方面找原因

shots.section_title: 鱼骨图：六个方面找原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: six small icons on the bones, a person, a machine, a bottle, a procedure sheet, a room and a ruler. No text.
shots.narration: 人、机、料、法、环、测，逐一找。

shots.section_title: 鱼骨图：六个方面找原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: each bone getting small icons such as a tired face, a heavy pipette and a missing schedule. No text.
shots.narration: 每个方面都写下可能的原因。

shots.section_title: 鱼骨图：六个方面找原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one cause on the fishbone circled in red with a root icon. No text.
shots.narration: 再圈出最根本、最关键的原因。

shots.scene: 短期：马上清理，阿杰休息
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cleaned bench with a check mark and the student resting on a chair with a cup of water. No text.
shots.narration: 短期纠正：马上清理，阿杰先休息。

shots.scene: 长期：换省力移液器，轮换排班
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lightweight electronic pipette and a shift schedule with two names alternating icons. No text.
shots.narration: 长期改进：换省力移液器，轮班。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a stop hand icon for the immediate risk and a gear icon for system change. No text.
shots.narration: 先止住眼前风险，再改制度流程。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an inverted pyramid of control measures with the top layers highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 措施优先改设备、改流程。

shots.scene: 报告只写下次注意，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report with only a single line and a warning icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只写“下次注意”，报告就没用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the report now containing icons of a new tool, a changed procedure and a schedule. No text.
shots.narration: 要提出改设备、改流程的措施。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a report going into a filing cabinet with dust on it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 写完规定归档，不算整改。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: students working with the new pipette and the new schedule, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 真正改变做法，事故才不会再来。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a task list with a person icon and a calendar date next to each item. No text.
shots.narration: 每项整改，定责任人、定期限。

shots.scene: 纠正止住问题，预防改变系统
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two arrows, one stopping a leak and one redesigning a system gear. No text.
shots.narration: 纠正止住问题，预防改变系统。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar page turning and an investigator checking the new schedule at the bench. No text.
shots.narration: 到期回头查，看措施管不管用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loop arrow from a failed check back to the plan step. No text.
shots.narration: 不管用，就重新分析再改。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shares the lessons learned at a group meeting, students taking notes.
shots.narration: 把教训讲给大家听，防止再犯。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one event icon with two arrows, one to an injury and one to spoiled experiment samples. No text.
shots.narration: 一次意外，可能既伤人又毁实验。

shots.scene: 两组人分头调查，结论打架，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two teams investigating separately and their reports clashing with lightning icons, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 分头调查，结论容易打架。

shots.scene: 一起调查，分别记录，统一整改
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one team investigating, two separate report forms, one shared action plan. No text.
shots.narration: 一起调查，分别记录，统一整改。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four shield icons in a row, each with a different small symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 国内处理事故，讲究四不放过。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a magnifier over a root icon with a lock. No text.
shots.narration: 事故原因没查清，不放过。

shots.scene: 责任人员没处理不放过
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a balance scale icon over a person icon. No text.
shots.narration: 责任人员没处理，不放过。

shots.scene: 整改措施没落实不放过
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrench icon over an unchecked task list. No text.
shots.narration: 整改措施没落实，不放过。

shots.scene: 有关人员没受教育不放过
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a group of students listening to a lesson with a light bulb icon. No text.
shots.narration: 有关人员没受到教育，不放过。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an accident record card being sorted into labeled drawer icons by type and injury. No text.
shots.narration: 事故按国家标准分类、编码。

shots.scene: 急救、就医、限制工作、误工、死亡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of icons from a plaster to a hospital bed, a restricted work icon, an empty desk and a black ribbon. No text.
shots.narration: 按伤害轻重，每一类都登记在案。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four steps of increasing size with person icons and money icons. No text.
shots.narration: 国内还按伤亡和损失划分事故等级。

shots.scene: 受限、误工的伤病都记录
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a register with entries for restricted work, lost days and a fatality icon. No text.
shots.narration: 受限、误工、死亡，都要记录。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a university office icon and a record book with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 按事故报告规定和学校制度登记。

shots.scene: 伤害率：次数按工时折算
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an injury count icon over a large clock of working hours, an equal sign and a small rate bar. No text.
shots.narration: 伤害率：伤害次数按工时折算。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small lab and a large institute side by side with comparable rate bars. No text.
shots.narration: 折算后，大小单位才能放在一起比。

shots.scene: 严重率：损失多少工作日
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar with many lost days marked, over a clock of working hours. No text.
shots.narration: 严重率：看损失了多少工作日。

shots.scene: 次数看频率，天数看严重
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a counter icon labeled as frequency and a calendar icon labeled as severity, side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 次数看频率，天数看严重程度。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rule book icon next to a simple formula card with blank symbols. No text.
shots.narration: 计算口径，以现行标准为准。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield icon, barrier tape and a camera icon. No text.
shots.narration: 确认安全，保护现场，及时取证。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chain of question marks reaching a root and a small fishbone diagram. No text.
shots.narration: 多问为什么，挖到系统根源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed loop arrow with a check mark and four shield icons. No text.
shots.narration: 整改跟踪验证，做到四不放过。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着烧杯和锥形瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a glass beaker and a conical flask and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，第15章：化学实验入门与玻璃仪器。
